description.blurb: S/2020 S 3 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Inuit group. It was discovered in 2020 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2020 S 3 is about 3 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 18.1 million km in 907.99 days. It has an inclination of 46.1° to the ecliptic in a prograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.144.
